name: COUPNUM
description: COUPNUM returns the number of coupon payments remaining from settlement to maturity for a bond.
tldr: Calculates the number of coupons payable between the settlement date and maturity date.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Number of coupon payments per year (1, 2, or 4).

basicExample.explanation: For a 10-year bond purchased on April 1, 2024 with semi-annual coupons, this returns 20.

howItWorks: COUPNUM calculates the remaining coupon payments based on the maturity date, frequency, and settlement date. It rounds up to the nearest whole coupon if settlement falls between coupon dates.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

limitations: Basis affects date calculations in some edge cases.

commonErrors.fix: Use DATE function or valid date serial numbers.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: COUPNUM works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between COUPNUM and COUPNCD?
faq.answer: COUPNUM returns the count of remaining coupons. COUPNCD returns the date of the next coupon.

faq.question: Does COUPNUM include the current coupon?
faq.answer: It counts all coupons from settlement to maturity, including partial periods.
